name: Malawi
description: Malawi from the Maravi kingdom and Livingstone to British Nyasaland, independence in 1964, Hastings Banda and a democracy since 1994.

checkpoints.name: Maravi
checkpoints.note: Farmers painted the rocks of Chongoni. The Maravi kingdom ruled the lake shores, and Ngoni and Yao peoples came in the 1800s.

checkpoints.name: Nyasaland
checkpoints.note: Livingstone reached the lake in 1859. Britain made the land a protectorate, and Chilembwe rose in 1915.

checkpoints.name: Independent Malawi
checkpoints.note: Malawi became independent in 1964. Banda ruled until 1994, when Malawians voted for multi-party democracy.
